notes: Site is a client-rendered NetSuite SuiteCommerce store (HTML shell returns no server-rendered content); qty could not be read from static HTML so Playwright was used (Tier 2) to render pages and discover the site's own JSON category-tree API (/api/navigation/v1/categorynavitems/tree) and item-count API (/api/cacheable/items, returns exact {"total":N}), both of which are reachable by plain HTTP/curl once found -- used those directly for all qty afterward, no further browser needed. robots.txt explicitly Allow:s ClaudeBot/Claude-Web. Checked: full XML sitemap (24,365 URLs, all PDPs, zero category URLs -- category pages are not in the sitemap), rendered main nav/mega-menu, and the full site category tree (676 nodes) for Christmas/Halloween/Diwali/Easter/Valentine/Thanksgiving/New Year/Hanukkah/Independence Day/Mother's-Father's Day/St Patrick's/spring-summer-fall-winter terms. Two genuine mixed-holiday umbrella branches exist (Home Decor > Holiday Decor; Gift Ideas > Holiday Gifts) -- kept as MANUAL REVIEW grouping rows per rule since no single holiday applies to the parent, with each child assigned its own real holiday. 'Holiday Figurines' (Herend) and 'Holidays & Annual Boxes' (Halcyon Days) are single leaf PLPs that likewise mix holidays (predominantly Christmas plus some Hanukkah/other) -- kept under the site's own name with MANUAL REVIEW flags rather than forced into one holiday. Excluded: 'Shop All Holiday Decor' (Shop All nav pattern, core rule); 'Gold Jewelry' and its 6 children nested under Christmas Gifts > Jewelry -- sampled items are generic gold jewelry (hoop earrings, bracelets, etc.) with zero Christmas theming, confirming it is the site's general jewelry catalog reused under this URL path, not a genuine Christmas category (rule 5/6), while the sibling 'Jewelry' node one level up (28 items, candy-cane earrings, gift-package earrings) is genuinely Christmas and was kept; 'Summer Limoges Boxes' -- sampled items are generic florals/butterflies/lighthouses with no seasonal-event association, just a merchandising theme name, fails the genuine-holiday test (rule 2/6); 'Inspiration > Seasonal Collections' (Bar Cart Necessities, Reading Nook, Time to Travel, etc.) -- editorial/marketing landing pages under Inspiration nav, not genuine holiday categories despite the 'Seasonal' label. Also found duplicate nav path /herend/holiday-figurines resolving to the identical category (internalid 647, identical count 91) as the canonical /collectibles/herend-figurines/holiday-figurines -- kept one row per overlap rule. 'Christmas Pewter' appears three times across the site (Collectibles > Pewter Art: 209; Home Decor > Holiday Decor: 101; Gift Ideas > Christmas Gifts: 157) with three different internalids and three different counts -- confirmed genuinely distinct listings, not duplicates, kept all three.
